text: {"lessons":["Short-term price changes are unpredictable, so I should not assume recent movements will continue.","My account value has fluctuated even when I made no trades; I should follow a long-term plan rather than react to every change.","Selling some Stock D after a large gain reduced my exposure while leaving me invested; I should make trade decisions based on my overall risk and needs, not just a stock’s gain versus its average cost."]}
